candidates.rationale: Three routes, service ended 2025-12-31, file last modified 2024-04-02 and named for a date in March 2024. One of three feeds from neighbouring rural operators in the same state that all end on that same date while none has been rebuilt since 2024, which points at a shared production arrangement that stopped rather than three independent lapses. The dated filename means a replacement will sit at a different URL.
